annotations.title: EU obligations checklist for an online shop

description: EU rules for an online shop: which EU and national obligations may apply to a web shop or marketplace seller selling into the EU, such as GPSR product safety and the EU responsible person, toys and cosmetics, packaging (PPWR, EPR registration), accessibility (European Accessibility Act), the online withdrawal button, customs on parcels from outside the EU and B2B e-invoicing (for example KSeF in Poland). Input: the EU countries the shop sells or ships to; optional: where the business is established (also outside the EU, for example China or the US), product categories and answers such as dropshipping from non-EU suppliers. Each rule comes with its status, start date, deadline, what to prepare and official sources with verification dates, plus follow-up questions. Sector rules are included for toys (Toy Safety Directive) and cosmetics (Cosmetics Regulation) only. It does not cover other product sectors, VAT or other taxes, data protection, or an assessment of a specific product. General information, not legal advice.

enterprise_size.description: Business size (SME size class): micro, small, medium or large

establishment_country.description: Country where the business or seller is established, as an ISO code; may be outside the EU, e.g. "CN" (China), "US", "GB" or "CH"

food_contact_packaging.description: Some packaging is in direct contact with food

has_non_eu_manufacturer.description: Some products are made by a manufacturer outside the EU, e.g. bought from non-EU suppliers, imported or dropshipped from China

nl_packaging_above_50t.description: Netherlands: places more than 50,000 kg of packaging on the Dutch market in a calendar year

ppwr_role.description: Role for packaging under the EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR), if known

product_categories.description: Product categories sold, as keys from list_markets_and_categories, e.g. toys, cosmetics, electronics, textiles, food, general_consumer

sells_b2b.description: Sells to businesses (B2B customers); used for the e-invoicing rules

sells_b2c.description: Sells to consumers (B2C, private customers); default true

ships_from_outside_eu.description: Some orders reach EU customers from outside the EU, e.g. from a non-EU warehouse or dropshipped from a non-EU supplier (customs on low-value parcels)

ships_physical_goods.description: Sells physical goods that are shipped to customers (false if the shop sells only digital products or services)

ships_to.description: EU countries the shop sells or ships to (target markets), as ISO codes, e.g. ["DE","FR","AT"] for Germany, France and Austria

vat_registered_in.description: EU countries where the business is registered for VAT, as ISO codes

name: eu_obligations_checklist
title: EU obligations checklist for an online shop
